items.title: Earl May interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2001
items.q: Oh I have no idea who that was. I have not a clue.

ctx.x: And when my mother came out to visit and she told me that my cousin, who was two years older than I was, is going to study the piano and she wanted to know what instrument I wanted to play, I said I don’t know what it’s called but I knew it had strings. You know, I’m thinking about the guitar. She gives me the violin. So I wound up studying the violin until I was about nine years old. And I hated it. But I’ve always had dreams from that record, of going in the basement, I’ve always had dreams of being on the…
Who do you suppose that was? Like Eddie Condon?
Oh I have no idea who that was. I have not a clue.
